name: arrow_launch
for: archer loose / low arrow, bounty_echo arrow / long draw / low arrow: release at the bow hand
notes: Bowstring release at the arrow rest, drawn for +x: the string snaps through in a thin pale crescent (frame 1) with a hard 4-point glint, air streaks shoot forward along the shot (frame 2), a faint see-through wisp and a few wood/fletch fibres drift down. Anchor = the bow hand / arrow rest. Play on the loose frame; start arrow_flight on frame 2.
